thread:
Mira (Docs): Heads up — Legal provided a compact residency blurb for Getting Started. We want this under getting-started/index.md as a short localized footnote. Can someone take the i18n key + snippet and wire up SDK examples?
Evan (Eng-ML): send the exact legal wording and preferred key. I can also scan the Go and Ruby snippets for region params.
Mira (Docs): Legal-approved line: "Requests served by EU endpoints are processed within the EU unless the customer enables cross-region routing. See the regions table for specifics." Use i18n key: getting_started.residency_note. Keep it terse (<= 150 chars).
Kai (DevEx): I'll add small code examples showing how to pick the region endpoint for JS + Go. Which path — docs/getting-started/index.md?
Mira (Docs): yes. Add the footnote immediately after the first paragraph under the Quickstart header. Add an inline parenthetical: (regional endpoints vary by model).
Sofia (L10n): I'll translate to de, pt-BR, and ko. Please share character limits for site banners vs footnotes.
Mira (Docs): Footnote only, so ~150 chars is fine. Include context in PR description.
Evan (Eng-ML): Proposed snippets:
```js
// JS: choose endpoint via endpoint option
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ endpoint: 'https://eu.api.redwood.ai' })
const r = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi' })
console.log(r.output)
```
and Go:
```go
// Go example: set RegionEndpoint
c := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{RegionEndpoint: "eu"})
resp, _ := c.Generate(context.Background(), redwood.GenerateParams{Model: "redwood-1", Prompt: "hello"})
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```
Kai (DevEx): I'll add a short sentence above blocks: "Use the endpoint/RegionEndpoint option to prefer routing to a geographic region; fallback may occur if the model isn't available."
Sofia (L10n): starting translations branch docs/residency-getstarted-i18n. I'll open PR and include locale files for de/pt-BR/ko.
pr-bot: PR opened by Sofia: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123 — includes i18n + code snippets. CI checks queued.
Evan (Eng-ML): Quick note: in the JS SDK we recently renamed the option to `serviceUrl` in v0.9.2; should we standardize on `endpoint` or `serviceUrl` in docs?
Mira (Docs): Good catch. Let's match the released SDK. Use `serviceUrl` everywhere. Please update snippets to `serviceUrl`. Add a one-line note: "If you use older SDKs, the option may be `endpoint`."
Kai (DevEx): updated the JS snippet to use `serviceUrl` and left the Go comment about RegionEndpoint (Go SDK still uses RegionEndpoint). Pushed as separate commit in PR.
Sofia (L10n): updated translations in branch; changed the context to mention footnote placement.
Evan (Eng-ML): added a unit test to the routing integration tests to assert that requests with serviceUrl set to EU hit the eu cluster. Pushed test to main-infra/tests.
Mira (Docs): When PR is green, we'll merge and add a short redirect from /residency -> getting-started footnote. Can someone do the redirect PR?
Kai (DevEx): I'll open a tiny redirects PR after merge.
Mira (Docs): Checklist: add footnote + i18n key (Kai/Mira), update snippets (Kai/Evan), translations (Sofia), SDK naming fix (Evan), tests (Evan). Merge after CI. Thanks all. :rocket:
